title: garments4 round 7: the joined shoulder on by default, the garments refit (regressions accepted)

summary.recommended: Merge with the joined shoulder ON by default (Michael's call, 2026-10-01: motion testing on the default body), as candidate g7_c7, and recover the garments in round 8 from separated references. The bare shoulder now matches the base body sheet (body_shoulder front/back IoU 0.674 -> 0.944 / 0.948; the shoulder line's dip and tilt FAIL -> PASS), and both 90-degree raises with the garments on stay clean (skin out of the puff at most 17 vertices, 0.025 L; the old body 18). Accepted regressions: art_outline_neck 1.47 -> 10.3, art_outline_collar 1.44 -> 3.47, bow_front_bleed 0 -> 0.147, the collar's torn edges, the sleeve's profile, piece_top front 0.749 -> 0.507 (-32%). Gate (c8d30430 into 27a4b6c3): the 15 garment regressions accepted by name; 5 blockers left, all the motion QA's remeasure bookkeeping (the 2x2's old measure can't read the joined body; the new measure reads the motion skirt checks identically on both geometries) and one stale motion record (motion_kick_skirt_inside, miscalibrated on today's skirt upstream): the coordinator's call.
asked: Nothing for Michael: informational (his decision of 2026-10-01 is applied). For the coordinator: accept the motion skirt checks' unmeasured 2x2 cells (motion_*_skirt_*: the new measure reads them the same on both geometries) and decide motion_kick_skirt_inside's record (miscalibrated on today's skirt: pipeline-3d itself reads 0.0071 WARN), or not?

Build CPU 1.01x; 107 test files pass.

Gate 3 (charkit/out/gate/gate_tool-garments4-shoulders_c8d30430_into_27a4b6c3.md): FAIL under K, 5 blockers, none the garments': the 2x2 couldn't run the old measure on the new geometry for motion_kick/squat_skirt_inside/stretch (pipeline-3d's motion code reads no skirt values on the joined body; the new measure: the same values on both geometries, 0.0071 W / 0.0796 P / 0.0171 I / 0.1338 P), and motion_kick_skirt_inside's record not refreshed (MISCALIBRATED on today's skirt). The 15 garment regressions are accepted by name (charkit/accepted/); build CPU 1.02x; 104 test files pass.

What round 7 fixed and measured: the skin strip on the shoulder (the radial neck cut's front plane reached 59 deg round the neck: bridge skin showing front 0.024 -> 0.0009 L^2); the V's notch (the throat's faces read as the back by the opening's front test: jacket vertices in the V 29 -> 0); art_speckle_neck and art_mirror_waist back to PASS; the body-shoulder checks calibrated (8 CALIBRATED; the axilla ships at WARN 0.038 / 0.047).

Tooling: the sweep's garments stage now re-masks the skin per row (validated against a real build: neck_crease 40 vs 40.0, art_outline_neck 11.8 vs 12.2), so changes to what the garments hide can be screened; a trap found in sweep optimize: its confirm builds charkit/spec/clawd.json unless confirm.spec is set (opt1's confirm built the old body).

Why the gate needs acceptances: on the joined shoulder the hull-conformed lapels crumple at the neck (art_outline_neck needs about one corner; the best of 230 optimizer evaluations and ~45 sweep rows reached 5.8), and the puffs' dome doesn't hold the bridge's top (the jacket shows over it: piece_top front 0.51 at best). The flat lapels (smoothed height field, decoupled V) are clean bands but not yet shaped right (collar 3q IoU 0.21-0.36, bleed 0.15-0.18): round 8, from separated references.
